_comment: The simulated internet for the W3 Ch4 lab, inherited from W2 Ch8. Every address is from a documentation
range (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849) and every ASN from the documentation ASN range (RFC 5398), so none of this
can ever point at a real network. demo_site/edge.py uses this file as its ASN/geo database; the
traffic generators use it to pick source addresses.
This file is the edge's *snapshot* of the world, built in lab week 0. The world moves on without it:
tools/weeks.py knows what changed each week, and tools/refresh_corpus.py writes the refresh to
data/world_updates.json, which edge.py and the header/TLS sensors read on top of this file.
Rules of engagement: attack scripts may only use addresses from these pools. 'resi-proxy' stands in
for a residential proxy product; no lab traffic ever goes through a real proxy.

resi-proxy._comment: A residential proxy product: exits inside a real ISP's ranges, same ASN as its customers. Bots only.

ja4._comment: Illustrative JA4 values, one per client stack, as captured in lab week 0. Capture real ones with the tools from W2 Ch5.
